Summary: KRYL-1388 (Plan): Extract and persist ownership position fields (percent, shares, voting and dispositive power) from Schedule 13G/13D filings
Description: 1) Original intent: the ownership record shows how much each holder owns and with what rights, from the filing, so the guest can see position size and (via KRYL-1386) its change (rubric item 3, decided 2026-10-09). 2) Acceptance criteria (for the plan): a written implementation plan, reviewed by the Founder, that covers: the field list and schema (identity, position, rights, timing, provenance, qualification, per the rubric); extraction from the structured primary_doc.xml for SCHEDULE 13G/13D (verified fetchable) and from legacy SC 13G/A text (percent row parsed 5 of 5; shares 3 of 5; CUSIP 3 of 5; the KRYL-1386 v1.1 fallbacks apply); persistence and caching; comparable-position rules (same CUSIP and reporting person; distinct filings); the sync lookback and form-type changes (about 48 months, both form families, request spacing); the five counterparty match outcomes; tests with the Alphabet fixtures (Vanguard Group 0%, Vanguard Capital Management 7.48% and 6.41%, Brin 5.81%, Schmidt 0.97 to 0.83) and the unverified-item closing procedures. 3) Current implementation state: the connectors read search metadata only (filer, date, form, accession); no position fields are extracted or stored. Fetching primary_doc.xml works through the existing document proxy. 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1386 v1.1 (magnitude, existence, reason codes; review pending), specs/decision-package-alphabet-rubric-20261009.md, SEC rate limits (requests spaced about 1.5 s, failures not cached). 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none known. 6) Maps to current product model: yes; section 20 (expose the relationship), section 21 (present reported values, never derive a verdict). No implementation authorized by this ticket.
